patterns_that_worked.lesson: LPASS_CDC_<macro> register defines can be mechanically localized and renamed to CDC_<macro> with offset preservation.
lpass-cdc, swr-wcd, clk-rsc, pinctrl, and version compatibility paths can be isolated into dedicated patches.
Runtime PM callback shape and standard SET_RUNTIME_PM_OPS pattern matched upstream behavior at the pattern level.
Deferring compatible/DT ABI guesses avoided creating unsupported binding changes.
Separating mechanical rename, removal, framework migration, helper integration, clock/runtime PM, and residual cleanup isolated likely maintainer concerns.

patterns_that_failed.missed: VA conversion kept downstream compatible handling instead of inferring upstream per-SoC data structures.
patterns_that_failed.detection_signal: Upstream driver has of_device_get_match_data, per-compatible .data, or binding compatible oneOf entries.

patterns_that_failed.missed: VA conversion modeled clock consumption but not fsgen clock provider registration.
patterns_that_failed.detection_signal: Binding contains clock-output-names or driver has clock registration / clk_hw / of_clk provider usage.

patterns_that_failed.missed: VA conversion retained parent regmap/manual ioremap instead of owning devm_regmap_init_mmio.
patterns_that_failed.detection_signal: Private data lacks struct regmap * and source calls dev_get_regmap(dev->parent, NULL).

patterns_that_failed.missed: VA conversion preserved downstream topology instead of reducing to upstream-style widget/route count.
patterns_that_failed.detection_signal: Converted DAPM widget/route/control count remains much larger than expected or preserves downstream-only SWR/SMIC controls.

patterns_that_failed.missed: Some helpers were SoC variant behavior, while others were architectural gaps; pipeline did not distinguish these automatically.
patterns_that_failed.detection_signal: Helper references private downstream state, delayed work, or parent framework objects after vendor framework removal.

pipeline_improvements.rule: After removing vendor framework, probe must use devm_regmap_init_mmio and private data must own struct regmap *; parent regmap indirection is a conversion gap.
If binding has clock-output-names, treat the macro as a clock provider and plan clk_hw registration, not only devm_clk_get consumers.
Any upstream LPASS macro conversion must introduce a per-SoC data model and of_device_id .data entries when compatibles differ by capability.
DAPM topology should be reduced toward upstream-style widget/route count; preserving all downstream widgets is a likely conversion gap.
Private data should own regmap, clocks, and power domains directly; no lpass-cdc device pointer lookup should remain.

reusable_qualcomm_lpass_patterns: Register rename: LPASS_CDC_<MACRO>_* -> CDC_<MACRO>_* for register symbols.
Framework removal: lpass-cdc macro_ops, swr-wcd notifications, msm-cdc-pinctrl, and lpass-cdc-clk-rsc are downstream-only integration layers.
lpass-macro-common integration: use lpass_macro_pds_init/exit for power domains and shared version helpers where applicable.
Clock provider registration: when the macro exports fsgen or clock-output-names, register clk_hw and use upstream clock framework ownership.
Fail-closed DT policy: do not invent or preserve downstream compatible strings/properties without binding evidence.
